caption: The drawing depicts a lidded urn or trophy-like vessel rendered in shades of grey pencil, positioned centrally on an off-white background with some small brownish spots. The vessel has a rounded, cup-shaped body that tapers smoothly into a stem atop a square base. Its lid is tall, narrowing upwards into a small decorative finial. On the front of the urn’s body, there is a monogram consisting of the letter "D" in an ornate script, surrounded by a double oval line with decorative dots. The shading of the urn suggests a metallic surface, creating the effect of highlights and shadows. The overall composition is symmetrical and centered, with ample blank space surrounding the object.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
